…It’s a gun!
Fuck! Fuck! Fuck! 
I need to figure out something or I’m fucked! 
If the police catch me with something like this it will be over for me!
I need to improvise and get some help!
You: Two policemen are going towards me…
It’s a lie of course, but it should buy me some time.
???: What? There shouldn’t be any.
???: Listen. This package cannot be discovered by them. For your own good.
You: I will hide in the building nearby and wait for them to pass. 
???: Alright.
You: I’m hanging up, I’m losing connection…
???: What? Wai-
That should buy me a few minutes…
Who can I call for help?
